title: Lipstick Pin Hit
description: Fire glossy lipsticks into a spinning beauty wheel without clipping another tube—nail three escalating rounds to win the glamorous grand prize.
controls: Tap anywhere to shoot a lipstick cleanly into an open gap on the rotating wheel.

zh-CN.title: 口红见缝插针
zh-CN.description: 抖音曾经刷屏全网的口红机见缝插针：瞅准转盘空档连射口红，连闯三关稳稳不碰刀直接带走大奖！
zh-CN.controls: 看准旋转圆盘上的空位点击屏幕射出口红，成功插满且不碰撞即可闯关。
